auth.title: auth
auth.description: The authentication type to use. `certificate` is the only supported value.

password.title: password
password.description: The password of your certificate file, when it is protected with one.

appId.title: appId
appId.description: The ID of the Entra app registration to authenticate with. Required, unless you pass it with the `--appId` option.

tenant.title: tenant
tenant.description: The ID of the tenant to authenticate to. Required, unless you pass it with the `--tenant` option.

certificate.title: certificate
certificate.description: The certificate to authenticate with. This can be the path to your certificate file (`.pfx`, `.p12`, or `.pem`), or its base64 encoded contents. Required, unless you pass it with the `--certificate` option.

commandName.title: commandName
commandName.description: Override the command used to execute the CLI for Microsoft 365. By default, `doctor` executes the commands through the bundled CLI for Microsoft 365 API.

commandTimeout.title: commandTimeout
commandTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds for each CLI for Microsoft 365 command which `doctor` executes. Increase this value when commands time out on large sites or slow connections.

overwriteImages.title: overwriteImages
overwriteImages.description: Specifies if you allow `doctor` to overwrite the images in the SharePoint library that are referenced in the markdown files.

url.title: url
url.description: The URL of the site collection to use.

folder.title: folder
folder.description: The folder location in where you will create your markdown files.

library.title: library
library.description: Specified the library which you want to use in SharePoint to store your referenced images and the publish state file.

webPartTitle.title: The webPartTitle schema
webPartTitle.description: This defined the title of the markdown web part to be created/updated on the page. Default value is: `doctor-placeholder.

pageTemplate.title: pageTemplate
pageTemplate.description: The name of the default page template to use for all the pages.

continueOnError.title: continueOnError
continueOnError.description: Continue when an error occurs during the publishing process.

verbose.title: verbose
verbose.description: Provides extended logging output. When enabled, the task list is rendered with the verbose renderer, so every task and its output stays visible instead of being collapsed.

timingDetails.title: timingDetails
timingDetails.description: Shows additional per-page timing statistics (average, fastest and slowest page) after the publishing run.

skipExistingPages.title: skipExistingPages
skipExistingPages.description: Will not overwrite pages if they already existed on the site.

skipPrecheck.title: skipPrecheck
skipPrecheck.description: Skips the pre-process validation which runs before any SharePoint calls are made.

forceAll.title: forceAll
forceAll.description: Reprocess all pages, ignoring the saved publish state. By default `doctor` only publishes pages which are new or whose content changed since the last run.

removeDeleted.title: removeDeleted
removeDeleted.description: Recycles the pages which are tracked in the publish state, but whose markdown file no longer exists. Requires the `--confirm` flag on the command execution.

disableStatePersistence.title: disableStatePersistence
disableStatePersistence.description: Disables loading and saving of the publish state file. When enabled, `doctor` cannot detect changes, so all pages are processed on every run.

stateFile.title: stateFile
stateFile.description: The path of the publish state file within the library defined by the `library` option.

applyTheme.title: applyTheme
applyTheme.description: Applies the theme defined in the `siteDesign.theme` property. Since v2.0.0 the theme is no longer applied automatically.

retryWhenFailed.title: retryWhenFailed
retryWhenFailed.description: Specifying this flag will retry the command if it failed. In some cases it can be that SharePoint failes to process your request, and this allows you to try again without running the whole flow from scratch.

cleanQuickLaunch.title: cleanQuickLaunch
cleanQuickLaunch.description: Allows you to specify if you want to remove all the navigation elements defined in the QuickLaunch navigation before adding the new navigation structure.

cleanTopNavigation.title: cleanTopNavigation
cleanTopNavigation.description: Allows you to specify if you want to remove all the navigation elements defined in the TopNavigation navigation before adding the new navigation structure.

disableComments.title: disableComments
disableComments.description: Disable comments on global level for all pages.

menu.title: menu
menu.description: Defines the static navigation stucture to get created.

siteDesign.title: siteDesign
siteDesign.description: Defines the design to apply to the site (theme, chrome header and footer).

logo.title: logo
logo.description: Set the logo for the site. The path is relative to the configured `folder` option.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: The name of the SharePoint theme. The theme is only applied when the `applyTheme` option is enabled.

chrome.title: Chrome
chrome.description: Site header and footer chrome settings.

headerLayout.title: headerLayout
headerLayout.description: The layout of the chrome header.

logoAlignment.title: logoAlignment
logoAlignment.description: Specify how to align the logo if `extended` header is used.

footerLayout.title: footerLayout
footerLayout.description: The layout of the chrome footer.

disableMegaMenu.title: disableMegaMenu
disableMegaMenu.description: Specify to disable the mega menu. This results in using the cascading navigation (classic experience).

hideTitleInHeader.title: hideTitleInHeader
hideTitleInHeader.description: Specify to hide the site title in the header.

disableFooter.title: disableFooter
disableFooter.description: Specify to disable the footer on the site.

markdown.title: markdown
markdown.description: Special markdown settings of how you want to render you content in SharePoint.

allowHtml.title: allowHtml
allowHtml.description: By default SharePoint renders the HTML. If you set this to `true`, it will allow Doctor to generate the HTML and allows you to make use of all HTML capabilities the tool has to offer.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: Specify the theme to use for the code blocks. Default is `Dark`.

shortcodesFolder.title: shortcodesFolder
shortcodesFolder.description: Specifies where the custom shortcodes can be retrieved.

tocLevels.title: tocLevels
tocLevels.description: Defines the heading levels to use in the table of contents.

extended.title: extended
extended.description: Renders the extended markdown syntax: emoji shortcodes, highlighted text, footnotes, definition lists and task lists. Requires `allowHtml` to be enabled.

partials.title: partials
partials.description: Reusable markdown snippets which can be included on your pages with the `<include file="..." />` tag.

folder.title: folder
folder.description: Specifies where the partials can be retrieved.

header.title: header
header.description: The partial which gets automatically added at the top of every page. Pages can opt out with `partials: false` or `partials: { header: false }` in their front matter.

footer.title: footer
footer.description: The partial which gets automatically added at the bottom of every page. Pages can opt out with `partials: false` or `partials: { footer: false }` in their front matter.

multilingual.title: multilingual
multilingual.description: Setting to specify if multilingual is enabled on the site and which languages are supported.

enableTranslations.title: enableTranslations
enableTranslations.description: Specifies if you want to enable or disable multilingual features on the site.

languages.title: languages
languages.description: The languages to enable on the site. Use the same locale names as the `localization` front matter (for example "nl-nl"), or the LCIDs SharePoint uses (for example 1043).

overwriteTranslationsOnChange.title: overwriteTranslationsOnChange
overwriteTranslationsOnChange.description: Specify whether the changes made to user-specified text in the default language should automatically overwrite the existing translations made in all alternate languages.

translator.title: translator
translator.description: Allows you to specify the Azure Translator Cognitive Service to machine translate your pages.

key.title: key
key.description: The subscription key of the Azure Translator Cognitive Service.

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description: The endpoint of the Azure Translator Cognitive Service.

region.title: region
region.description: The region of the Azure Translator Cognitive Service.
